text:
Anna (Design): Pushing a compact iteration for the latency dashboard: p95 main line, optional p99, heatmap with density slider, time-range presets, and a sampling/fidelity control. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/latency-compact

Miguel (Product): Nice. Make p95 default. p99 should be one click toggle and show whether it99s approximate.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Agreed on defaults. Note: exact p99 is expensive for long ranges/high-card routes. We should do approximate p99 for ranges >24h unless exact is requested.

Mark (Eng-ML): Suggested approach: reservoir sampling for approximate p99; exact on demand. Expose a header like `X-Exact-Tail: true` for Dedicated customers.

Anna (Design): UI idea: solid p95, dotted p99 with a small "approx" badge when approximation applies. Tooltip: "p99 may be approximate for ranges >24h".

Jules (Accessibility): Accessibility nits: dotted line color fails contrast. Must be >=4.5:1. Also keyboard focus on the metric toggle and aria-describedby for the tooltip.

Anna (Design): Will update colors and add focus rings + ARIA labels.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Heatmap backend: prefer aggregated counters per bucket/min by default. Expose sampling levels: auto/low/med/high. We'll map those to query param `sampling_level`.
